changes.old_text: The warehouse is quiet. John walks in holding a flashlight.
changes.new_text: The warehouse is dark. John walks in holding a flashlight. Suddenly, a MASSIVE EXPLOSION rocks the building. The structural beams groan and spark. John is thrown onto a 15-foot high scaffold.

deltas.impact: The scene has changed from DAY to NIGHT. This requires a complete night lighting setup for a dark warehouse, managing the flashlight source, and coordinating interactive lighting effects to simulate the massive explosion and sparks.
A massive explosion has been added to the scene. This requires pyrotechnics, controlled sparking effects on the structural beams, and simulated smoke or debris.
John is now thrown onto a 15-foot high scaffold. This requires a stunt double, wire rigging, harness work, and safety fall protection/mats.
Requires the sourcing and construction of a safe, structurally sound 15-foot scaffold that can accommodate stunt work, as well as structural beams designed to show damage or spark.
Requires rigging support for the 15-foot stunt fall/throw, as well as blackout tents or flags to control light for the new NIGHT setting.
